body:
Some stories stay with you a lifetime …

 Cory and the Seventh Story   is a resource to help kids recognize six stories that lead to sadness and fighting … and to explore a seventh story that leads to peace and happiness. It’s written for young readers (ages 6 – 10), but it’s relevant for adults of all ages too.

 It’s available for pre-order now – for Christmas delivery. I co-wrote Cory with Irish peace-activist Gareth Higgins, and award-winning Heather Lynn Harris illustrated it with amazing artwork..

 You can also pre-order our companion e-book for adults, The Seventh Story: Us, Them, and the End of Violence.

 You can learn more here and order here.
